messages:
noah: kicking off staged canary v2026.4 -> 3% global (start with eu-west + us-east). No schema changes. Please watch latency, 5xx, and kv cache heat.

deploy-bot: [DeployBot] rollout id r-340c started: v2026.4 -> 3% (eu-west, us-east). Monitors: p95, 5xx-rate, kvcache-miss.

tara: seeing p95 bump in us-east for embed route from 390ms -> 820ms on tiny sample. No 5xx spike yet but kv miss rate up.

noah: can we run a 0.5% probe in us-east only while leaving eu-west at 3%? prefer to isolate.

ops-lead: auto-fallback policy: if p95 > 1.7x baseline OR 5xx delta > 0.5% -> auto-pin. Current us-east p95 ~2.1x, trigger met.

noah: ok aborting us-east canary to stable and leaving eu-west. deploy-bot, please pin us-east to v2026.3 and pause us-east traffic.

deploy-bot: [DeployBot] pausing r-340c for us-east. To pin: `rbctl pin r-340c us-east v2026.3 --reason "p95 embed tail"`

infra: warming +2 nodes in us-east and enabling kv-prefetch for embed route. ETA ~4m.

tara: I'll run a small eval comparing outputs once warm. If outputs are equivalent and tail improves, we can run 0.5% probe then resume 3%.

(deploy-bot) 6m later: probe-run: us-east 0.5% for 8m with guardrail p95 <= 1.4x and 5xx <= 0.3% -> PASS.

noah: great. resume gradual ramp back to 3% after 10m stabilization. Keep stricter thresholds for first 20m.

deploy-bot: [DeployBot] us-east resumed -> incremental increase to 3% (completed).

ops-lead: action items: (1) add 0.5% probe step to staged rollout playbook, (2) default kv-prefetch for heavy-embed routes, (3) postmortem note. Leaving thread open for tracking.

noah: thanks everyone, updating release notes and changelog.
